The objective for the Blues focused on utilizing control through central midfield, maintaining high pressing, and securing their first win of the campaign in front of their home supporters. Concurrently, the mission for Michael Skubala's Bristol City involved remaining compact in defense, absorbing early pressure, and exploiting space on quick counter-attacks to earn a result on the road.
